get.description: Reads a UTF-8 text slice from a registered virtual path. Returns `{"offset", "data"}` where `data` is a JSON string (use `/files/download` for raw binary bytes, #582) and `offset` echoes the starting byte offset of the returned chunk (or the file size when `offset=-1`), so log tailers compute the next poll offset as `offset + len(data)` (#241).

FrameworkCapability.description: Framework capability type (include/medios/v1/medios.proto). SHARED_RESOURCES opts in to node-declared store/<name> shared resource offers when gated (DR-036). Note: on-behalf-of TaskInfo.principal delegation is governed by the ACT_FOR_PRINCIPAL authorizer ACL action (DR-037), not a FrameworkInfo.Capability.

name.description: Declared node store name advertised as shared resource store/<name> (DR-036).

exclusive.description: When true on an RW volume, claims all writer units of the store.

TaskData.description: Store mount attribution stamped by the controller on TaskStatus.stores (DR-036).

path.description: Relative sandbox path when source is FILE (no '..' components).

pattern.description: ECMAScript regular expression (std::regex) where capture group 1 is work percent in [0, 100] and optional capture group 2 is the progress message.

action.description: Required when stall_window is set. KILL terminates the task with TASK_FAILED and REASON_PROGRESS_STALLED (DR-040).

ProgressPolicy.description: Task progress sampling and stall-detection policy (DR-040).

TaskProgress.description: Typed task progress snapshot carried on TaskStatus.progress (DR-038).

TaskObserver.description: Sidecar observer command run in the task sandbox beside the task (DR-041).

TaskFinish.description: Post-exit hook command run in the task sandbox after the work command exits, bounded by cap (DR-042).

FinishStatus.description: Outcome of TaskInfo.finish reported on the terminal TaskStatus.finish (DR-042).

principal.description: Task principal copied from TaskInfo.principal and exposed in /state and GET_STATE/GET_TASKS (DR-037).

framework_principal.description: Bound FrameworkInfo.principal stamped by the controller and exposed in /state and GET_STATE/GET_TASKS (DR-037).

ControllerCall.description: Placeholder schema for medios.v1.controller.Call. This follows ProtoJSON field naming; detailed generated schemas will replace it in a later phase.

get_nodes.description: Node inventory partitioned into registered `nodes`, failover-pending `recovered_nodes`, and registry-retained `unreachable_nodes` (where only `id` and `unreachable_time` survive; full `NodeInfo` is not retained once marked unreachable).
